industries: Biotech and pharmaceuticals, academic medical centers and asset management define a compliance-heavy project market.
intro:
Boston's project economy runs on knowledge industries: the biotech capital of the world in Kendall Square, hospitals that double as research empires, asset managers steering trillions, and universities spinning out startups continuously. Project roles here often carry regulatory weight — clinical trials, FDA submissions, financial compliance — which is where PMP-style formal method earns its premium; the software and robotics scene hires on Scrum credentials. There are live online batches all year for Boston — pick a Saturday–Sunday weekend or a Wednesday–Thursday weekday cohort — each timed to fall within normal Boston working-day hours; the schedule below gives the precise local start and end for every date. The package holds constant: live instruction, exam application help, calibrated mocks, and trainer access until you clear.

Boston's project economy runs on regulated innovation: biotech and pharma programs governed by validation requirements, hospital systems running perpetual modernization, and the financial and academic institutions layered around them.
